description: This source file implements submodule management functionalities in Git, including operations like reading and writing .gitmodules files, updating submodule paths, handling submodule repository updates, push/pull operations, and managing submodule states and configurations.

classes.name: struct collect_changed_submodules_cb_data
classes.description: Holds context for callbacks used while collecting changed submodules, including repository reference, list of changed submodules, and specific commit object id.

classes.name: struct changed_submodule_data
classes.description: Stores information about a submodule that has changed, including the superproject commit id, the submodule path, and array of new commit ids.

classes.name: struct fetch_task
classes.description: Represents a fetch operation targeted at a specific submodule, including repository info, fetch arguments, commit references, and cleanup flags.

classes.name: struct submodule_parallel_fetch
classes.description: Contains all state needed to perform parallel fetches of multiple submodules, including options, repository references, and progress tracking.
